title: 1. Intake / Search
purpose: Capture destination, dates, and guest count to drive relevant results and set initial context for the entire booking flow.
userDecision: Does the search surface match what I expect for my trip? Do I have enough control to refine before seeing inventory?
mockSource: Client-side mock-items.json + simple filter on city/name. No real inventory service.
proofCondition: User can enter destination + dates + guests and trigger an action that visibly updates the Results Grid below.
seoNotes: H1 or strong heading should contain primary search terms. Meta description would describe 'book hotels in {city}' for the live page.
schemaNotes: Consider HotelSearch or LodgingReservation schema on real page. Search form should be crawlable.

title: 2. Results Grid
purpose: Present a scannable, filterable set of hotel options with clear price, rating, and key value props. Primary surface for comparison and selection.
userDecision: Which property best fits my needs, budget, and location preferences?
primaryAction: Select hotel → navigate focus to Detail/Selection
mockSource: mock-items.json filtered client-side. Thumbnails are deterministic picsum seeds.
proofCondition: Clicking 'Select & View' on a card sets selectedHotelId in Demo State, scrolls/focuses the Detail section, and the Detail surface reflects the choice.
seoNotes: Each result card should map to a potential <a> to real /hotel/{slug} with proper heading structure.
schemaNotes: ItemList + Hotel structured data per result on production. Review rating aggregate.

title: 3. Detail / Selection
purpose: Deep dive on the chosen hotel + rate selection. Surface room types, policies, and value comparison so the user can commit to a specific inventory item.
userDecision: Is this room type acceptable for my party, dates, and price tolerance?
primaryAction: Select room/rate → advance to Checkout Preview with selectedRoomId written
mockSource: Rooms nested inside the selected hotel object from mock-items.json.
proofCondition: Selecting a room card updates Demo State with selectedRoomId. The Checkout Preview section immediately reflects the chosen hotel + room + estimated total.
seoNotes: Canonical URL would be the real hotel detail. Rich photos + description for social/SEO.
schemaNotes: LodgingReservation + Offer + Room type schema. AggregateRating. BreadcrumbList.

title: 4. Checkout Preview / Operation-State Stub
purpose: Summarize the committed selections before the real payment/guest details step. Also acts as a stub for operation state machine (valid, missing info, payment pending, failed, confirmed).
userDecision: Are my selections correct? What is the current operational status of this booking intent?
primaryAction: Simulate operation transitions (valid → payment-pending-demo → etc.). No real payment or confirmation.
mockSource: Purely derived from current demo state + hard-coded operation state transitions. No backend.
proofCondition: The summary shows live hotel + room + dates. Buttons that call setOperationState visibly change the currentOperationState badge and log the transition in the Demo State panel.
seoNotes: On a real checkout this surface would be the review step before POST /reserve. Keep form fields crawlable if guest info were here.
schemaNotes: ReservationPending or potential for Order + Reservation schema. Mark as demo-only.
